mentions.name: netflix_challenge
mentions.description: This project revisits the Netflix Prize challenge using LLMs, running experiments to push recommendation accuracy past the 9% improvement mark toward the 10% goal.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm revisiting the Netflix Prize challenge with LLM. So far I've hit the 9% improvement mark within a couple weeks. I seem to have hit a wall in the last week or so with no further progress. I'm hopeful to hit the 10% goal with one of the many experimentations though.
